candidate_047_scope_update.name: validated-executable-state re-anchoring + budget-aware branch arbitration
candidate_047_scope_update.finding: ScienceFlow does transfer as a full system to SciModelingBench under a matched DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Preview backbone, two-hour limit, fixed 8-20 batch-submission quota, CPU-only resources and hidden trusted evaluators. Its group-balanced score is 54.41 versus 51.39 for Pi, with top-two placement on 11/12 tasks. However, each system-task pair is run once and the ESTRA/execution-controller component ablations are reported only on MLE-bench Lite. Therefore the causal component evidence for re-anchoring remains ML-engineering-scoped; scientific-modeling transfer is system-level evidence, not component-level proof.
candidate_047_scope_update.scope_guard: Do not claim that ESTRA's ablated causal effect has been demonstrated on scientific modeling.

candidate_054.name: typed research-memory authority split: hard operational contracts + soft strategic lessons
candidate_054.mechanism_hypothesis: Separate research memory by authority and failure cost. Operational invariants such as metric definitions, output schemas, provenance/data-lineage conventions, environment facts and repeatedly verified failure constraints may be promoted into hard or strongly enforced contract memory after validation. Strategic memories such as preferred model families, hypotheses, search directions and mechanism beliefs remain confidence-scoped, recency/contradiction-sensitive soft priors with explicit diversity escape routes; they must not become hard constraints merely because an earlier branch succeeded.

primary_evidence.source: HPC-AutoResearch: Adapting Autonomous Research Systems for HPC through Split-Phase Execution (April 2026 preprint/workshop paper)
primary_evidence.comparison: Same Himeno task/environment/configuration, compressed inference memory enabled versus disabled.
primary_evidence.mechanistic_observation: Memory-enabled runs preserved a unified measurement convention and all listed stability metrics across stages; without memory, later stages reinvented output structures, Pareto hypervolume was never computed and Stage 4 omitted CV and p99/median. Repeated path/schema failures also recurred without memory.
primary_evidence.limits: Single run per condition with approximately 160 node evaluations; authors explicitly leave multi-seed replication to future work. The automated paper-review score is identical, so this supports execution consistency/repeated-error avoidance more strongly than final scientific quality.

primary_evidence.source: AlphaLab: Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Across Optimization Domains with Frontier LLMs, arXiv:2604.08590
primary_evidence.comparison: GPT-5.2 LLM-speedrun ablations use the same hardware, 50-experiment budget and shared Phase-2 harness.
primary_evidence.mechanistic_observation: The persistent playbook records working and failed strategies, but its single-run 2.5% apparent gain is inside the full-system stochastic spread and approximately equal to the five-run full mean. In traffic forecasting, the Opus playbook converged early on TFT and never explored iTransformer, while GPT-5.2 found an iTransformer configuration that ultimately scored better, illustrating a plausible strategy-memory lock-in failure.
primary_evidence.limits: No-playbook was a single ablation run; do not claim robust playbook benefit or harm. The iTransformer miss is descriptive, not a matched causal ablation of memory authority.

candidate_054.status: New mechanism hypothesis supported by complementary evidence: operational memory has direct but single-run execution benefits, while strategic playbook benefit is variance-sensitive and can coincide with premature convergence. The hard-vs-soft authority split itself remains untested as a matched intervention.
candidate_054.falsifier: A matched multi-seed autonomous-research experiment in which hard operational memory plus soft/diversity-gated strategic memory fails to outperform either undifferentiated hard playbook memory or no memory on both execution consistency and held-out scientific outcome quality.
